thread.promise: What it does, how to set it up, and where to find it:
replies: Long prompts get expensive fast. Every repeated instruction and pasted document is billed again on each call, and much of it adds nothing the model needs.
{NAME} is an open-source library that compresses a prompt before you send it. It drops low-value tokens and keeps the parts the answer depends on.
In its own benchmark it reduces token usage by 30% with no change to your prompts or your model. It is MIT licensed, so you can use it at work too.
Setup takes one line: pip install toolx. Then pass your prompt through its compress call right before the request goes out.
Go to GitHub and search for: {REPO}
